description: The file defines the EmployeeService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing various methods to manage employee data including CRUD operations, event dispatching, and subordinate/supervisor relations.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, subordinate and supervisor relationship management, and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeEventService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeTerminationService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns the instance of IDGeneratorService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves the Employee object to the database and dispatches a saved event.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Generates a new ID for the employee and saves it.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating a new employee has been added.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates employee personal details and records the event.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates employee job details and records the event.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating the employee's join date has changed.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object by employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees, optionally including terminated employees.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate employee numbers under a supervisor, optionally including the chain.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate Employee objects under a supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks whether a given employee is a supervisor.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their employee numbers and dispatches deletion event.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns a list of supervisor employee numbers for a subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns employee data as an array for a given employee number.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Returns list of employees available for a work shift based on search filters.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers that cannot be deleted.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Validates if an email is unique, optionally ignoring current email.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Validates if an employee ID is unique, optionally ignoring current ID.
